journeys.help: 📋 Real first-season fixtures in 10 leagues. A new 2026/27 career in one of these leagues, in the unedited modern world, uses the real opponent order and home/away venues: Premier League, EFL Championship and Serie A (the list as first published in June 2026); La Liga, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Süper Lig and Ligue 2 (the list as it stood on 10 October 2026); Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga (the list as first published in July 2026). A match moved after that is not followed. Calendar dates, kick off times and every match result are simulated. Example: Everton start at home to Crystal Palace, then visit Bournemouth. Other leagues, custom clubs, edited worlds, older saves, later seasons and a job you take part way through a season keep generated fixtures. Your Calendar names the two sources for your league.
